work.title: Embracing Lovers
work.description: A pale street wall hosts a loose orange-and-black mural of two embracing figures painted in continuous-line gesture, with red accents marking face and hands. A Mr. Snowmann stands at left wearing a Pierrot hat; a snowman trio anchors the lower-left base. Signed 'Ricky Bird'.
work.composition: central figure mural with snowman witnesses
